name: const unsafe fn read_unaligned < T > (src : * const T) -> T
rule: If `T` is not `Copy`, using both the value returned by `read_unaligned::<T>(src)` and the value at `*src` can violate memory safety, because the returned value is a bitwise copy rather than an ownership-preserving move.
api: const unsafe fn read_unaligned < T > (src : * const T) -> T
